title: Medicine
description: Ozone therapy and ozonation in medicine: sterilization of operating rooms and wards, disinfection of medical equipment, treatment of dental offices, rehabilitation centers and ambulances.

ambulances.title: Ambulances
ambulances.heroText: Fast ambulance cabin disinfection in 20-30 minutes between calls. Mobile ozone generators from 220V/230V mains power. Complete treatment of all surfaces and equipment.
ambulances.content:
Ambulances transport patients with various infectious diseases. Fast and effective disinfection between calls is critical to prevent infection spread.

Ambulance interior ozonation takes 20–30 minutes and ensures full disinfection of all surfaces: stretchers, equipment, handrails, floor, walls and ceiling. The gas penetrates seat upholstery and hard-to-reach areas.

Traditional wiping with disinfectants cannot achieve the same level of treatment as gas disinfection. Ozone reaches areas inaccessible to manual wiping and destroys pathogens in the air.

Mobile ozone generators for ambulances run from 12V or 24V vehicle power. Equipment is compact and can be stored in the cabin. After treatment, ventilate for 10–15 minutes. The vehicle is ready for the next call.

intro.text: Ambulances daily transport patients with various infectious diseases: ARVI, tuberculosis, COVID-19, intestinal infections. Without quality disinfection between calls, the vehicle becomes a source of cross-infection.
intro.text2: Ozonation is an effective method of express disinfection for medical transport. In 20-30 minutes, ozone destroys pathogenic microorganisms on all surfaces, including hard-to-reach places inaccessible during manual wiping.

highlight1.title: Critical necessity:
highlight1.text: According to research, a wide spectrum of pathogens is found on surfaces in ambulance cabins, including antibiotic-resistant strains. Traditional wiping covers only 60-70% of surfaces.

problem.title: Ambulance disinfection challenges
problem.text: Existing disinfection methods have significant limitations:
items: Limited time between calls — lengthy treatment is impossible
Hard-to-reach places — gaps, seat upholstery, ventilation
Variety of surfaces — metal, plastic, fabric, electronics
Medical equipment — not all disinfectants are safe for devices
Residual chemical odors — discomfort for next patients

process.title: Ozonation process
process.text: Express ozone disinfection is conducted in several simple steps:

steps.title: Preparation
steps.description: Closing cabin windows and doors. Installing mobile ozone generator. Connecting to 220V/230V electrical supply or external source.

steps.title: Ozonation
steps.description: Turning on ozone generator for 15-20 minutes. Ozone concentration reaches 20-30 mg/m³, ensuring pathogen destruction.

steps.title: Exposure
steps.description: Maintaining concentration for 5-10 minutes. Ozone penetrates upholstery, equipment gaps, ventilation system.

steps.title: Ventilation
steps.description: Opening doors, ventilating for 10-15 minutes. Ozone decomposes to oxygen. Vehicle is ready for call.

process.highlight: The entire process takes 30-45 minutes. When used during refueling or technical break, it does not reduce crew efficiency.

equipment.title: Equipment for ambulances
equipment.text: Mobile ozone generators are specifically designed for use in ambulances:

features.title: Compact size
features.description: Dimensions allow storing ozone generator in cabin. Device weight 3-5 kg. Does not take much space.

features.title: 220V/230V operation
features.description: Connection to vehicle power through cigarette lighter or terminals. Portable battery operation possible.

features.title: Automatic timer
features.description: Programmable operating modes. Automatic shutdown upon cycle completion. Sound signal.

features.title: Ease of use
features.description: One-button control. No special training required. Instructions on device body.

benefits.title: Benefits for ambulance service
items: Fast disinfection between calls — does not reduce efficiency
Complete treatment of all surfaces, including upholstery and ventilation
Operation from electrical supply — no external power sources needed
Destruction of antibiotic-resistant bacteria and viruses
benefits.warning: During ozonation, staff must not be in the cabin. Ozone MAC in work area — 0.1 mg/m³. Modern mobile ozone generators are equipped with timers and sound alarms.
